text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hello-lo, you called? It's me, Big Sis<n>Ines!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, are you hiding? I know it's<n>embarrassing
when you call<n>someone the wrong thing, but I want
to see you!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Three Goddesses? I don't<n>suppose you've
seen a shy kid<n>around here?
